description: Change of use of existing building from a drinking establishment (class A4) to a flat (class C3) on ground floor and basement level. Retain residential use on first floor and erect a single storey side extension to create a new single -storey dwelling in the north of the site
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (461-08-000-A1, 10407se-01, 10407se-05, design and Access Statement 461, Marketing Report dated November 2017 prepared by Jenkins Law, Environmental Noise Report 9542 rev 1 dated Friday 20th October 2017 prepared by Soundtesting Ltd, 9692-MP-01 Maintenance schedule, 9692 Specification for landscape softworks received on 07/02/2018. 461-08-031-A1, 461-PL01-003-A1 rev A, 461-PL01-002-A1 rev A received on 17/04/2018. 461-PL01-001-A1 rev B, 461-00-004-A1 rev B and 461-PL01-050-A1 rev B received on 30/04/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the arrangements for the management and storage of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development hereby permitted, a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before any part of the buildings are occupied.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 6 - During the course of the development:
a. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess any such additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
b. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clause a) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 7 - Nothwithstanding the submitted plans and prior to occupation of any dwelling on site, full details of the access, including the alterations to form a residential crossover and associated highway works shall be submitted to and agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of any dwelling and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 8 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development hereby approved, full details of the cycle stores shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of any dwelling and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 9 - The landscaping shall be implemented in accordance with the details shown on plans 461-00-004-A1 rev B received on 30/04/2018 and in approved specifications 9692 and 9692-MP-01 received on 07/02/2018 prior to the occupation of any part of the development hereby approved, bar the area adjacent to the vehicular access to the site and between the vehicular access and the disabled parking space wherein no planting or other structure shall exceed 0.6 metres in height.
The development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved management plan for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 10 - Prior to commencement of development, a detailed energy statement shall be submitted to, and approved in writing, by the Local Planning Authority. The Energy statement shall include the following:
I.	detail how the development will result in a reduction in emissions compared to the existing vuilding
II.	ensure a maximum internal water consumption rate of 105 litres/per person/per day (with an additional maximum external water allowance rate of 5 litres).
In addition the statement shall detail how the development will meet the following standards in relation to materials:
- At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
- At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
- No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be constructed to achieve the recommended internal noise levels as specified in Table 5.1 of British Standard BS8233:2014. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the noise mitigation measures recommended in the approved Environmental Noise Report 9542 rev 1 dated Friday 20th October 2017 prepared by Soundtesting Ltd and so maintained at all times thereafter.
Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted post completion noise tests shall be carried out by accredited/approved organisations in order to demonstrate that this has been achieved. The test reports shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
Noise tests shall be carried out taking account of worst case environmental conditions, such as easterly operations at Heathrow, peak time traffic flows wind speed, direction and presence of temperature inversion. Continuous logged data shall be submitted, together with parameters measuring LAeq, 16 hours during day-time (07:00 - 23:00) and Bedroom = 30 dB LAeq, 8 hours during night-time (23:00 - 07:00), LA90 for day and night and LAFmax at 1m from external fa?ade. LAFmax 45dB inside bedrooms is applicable by default, even though this metric has been excluded from BS8233:2014; and design limit specified in BS8233:2014 for external amenity areas is also equally applicable and shall be tested for compliance.
Condition : 12 - The basement shown on approved plan 461-08-000-A1 shall only be used as landlord storage and for no other purpose.

Condition : 13 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development hereby approved, a Car Park Management Plan for the whole site, including allocation of spaces, markings and signage to ensure the turning area remains free of parked vehicles at all times, and means to ensure the turning area is managed and enforced, should be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
